crossRefs.note: They have set their mouth in the heavens. Their tongue walks through the earth.
He says in his heart, “God has forgotten. He hides his face. He will never see it.”
They say, “Yah will not see, neither will Jacob’s God consider.”
You say, ‘What does God know? Can he judge through the thick darkness?
Thick clouds are a covering to him, so that he doesn’t see. He walks on the vault of the sky.’

won’t God search this out? For he knows the secrets of the heart.
Yahweh, you have searched me, and you know me.

translations.web: They say, “How does God know? Is there knowledge in the Most High?”
translations.bsb: The wicked say, “How can God know? Does the Most High have knowledge?”
translations.kjv: And they say, How doth God know? and is there knowledge in the most High?
translations.asv: And they say, How doth God know? And is there knowledge in the Most High?
